data.desc: Asbury Automotive Group, Inc. (NYSE: ABG), a Fortune 500 company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, is one of the largest automotive retailers in the U.S. In 2026, Asbury announced key strategic initiatives for growth as its Five Pillars: increasing new vehicle market share, driving profitable growth in used vehicles, re-establishing consistent growth in customer pay gross profit, managing SG&A and leveraging technology. As of September 30, 2026, Asbury operated 155 new vehicle dealerships, consisting of 197 franchises that represent 34 domestic and foreign brands of vehicles, and 37 collision repair centers. Asbury also operates Total Care Auto, Powered by Asbury, a leading provider of service contracts and other vehicle protection products.
